description: Browse the Kingdom Hearts merchandise catalog by character, budget and purpose. Use it to answer "what merch exists for X?" or "gift ideas under ¥5,000". Example: {ip: "kingdom-hearts", character: "Sora", budget_jpy: 5000, purpose: "display"}. Returns items[] (sku_id, name_en/name_ja, official, original price msrp_jpy plus price_local/currency, price_basis, region, availability_hint, typical_channels, source_url) and total_matches. If a character has no solo merch (e.g. Xigbar), the result also has suggested_character_group and suggested_items for their group (e.g. Organization XIII). Lists catalog entries only; it does not mean anything is for sale right now. Use explain_product with a sku_id for full details.

budget_jpy.description: Maximum original price in Japanese yen (overseas items are compared at a fixed rate), e.g. 5000. Optional.

character.description: Character name in English or Japanese, e.g. "Sora", "ソラ", "Organization XIII". Partial match. Optional.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 10). total_matches always gives the full count.

purpose.description: "display" = figures, plush, prizes, acrylic stands; "wear" = apparel; "read" = books; "play" = games and cards; "any" (default).

terms.description: Filter by series vocabulary (factions, worlds, keyblades, songs…) found in item names, aliases or notes. Optional.

names.description: Only items mentioning these series terms, in English or Japanese, e.g. ["Heartless"], ["XIII機関"], ["Kingdom Key"].

types.description: Only items mentioning a series term of these kinds (character/faction/world/item/keyblade/song/event/other).

name: discover
